messages.subject: error in building 4-d array for hierarchical distance analysis temp emigration from AHM book
parts:
I have am getting an error when running the code from the Applied Hierarchical Modeling book example (pg 500) regarding building and filling a 4-d array. I don't know why the error is occurring. I would appreciate recommendations on how to fix. Please see code below. Thanks.

>library("AHMbook")
>set.seed(1234)
>str(tmp <- simHDSopen("point", nreps=7, nyears=5, nsites=100))
>attach(tmp)

>delta <- 0.5
>nD <- B%/%delta 
>midpt <- seq(delta/2, B, delta) 

> y4d <- array(0,dim=c(nsites, nD, K, nyears))
> for(yr in 1:nyears){
+ for(rep in 1:K){
+ data <- tmp$data[[yr]][[rep]]
+ site <- data[,1]
+ dclass <- data[,"d"]%/%delta + 1
+ ndclass <- B%/%delta
+ dclass <- factor(dclass, levels= 1:ndclass)
+ y4d[1:nsites,1:nD,rep,yr] <- table(site, dclass)
+ }
+ }
Error in y4d[1:nsites, 1:nD, rep, yr] <- table(site, dclass) : 
  number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length
